title: The Crossing — The Morning upon the Fourteen Flames
narration_slice: Imagine the morning upon the Fourteen Flames when that threshold was crossed at last. High on a windswept ledge of black basalt, a young Valyrian clad in heat-cured leather and bronze chains lays bare hands against copper-bronze scales hot enough to raise blisters on mortal skin.
filing_note: Frames filed under assets/batch_058/ and uploaded to Drive folder EP001_BATCH_058_IMG0571-0580 (1HRhnRi6xwyjBajNIuoexppS9yMpF5WAv); all ten checksums re-read from Drive and matched. IMG0572 completed the mandatory 2x limb check on revision 1; the superseded first pass (1iZeZouFwKoQ1X4QvDzq9MT2qL0FHb6vZ) was moved to Drive trash after verification. Batch closed 10/10 — NOT a zero-rejection batch: one frame required a revision.
the_crossing_rule: The testimony register ends with 0570; this batch opens the staging register. For the first time in 120+ frames a person shares the frame with the dragon. Book-canon Anatomy Rule intact: strictly four limbs; the rider is never a face — from behind, above the shoulder, silhouette, or hands only. Contact, never consequence: the hot scales are touched, never blistered. First raking sandstone light is permitted now (the dramatization is awake); no disc, no shafts, no god-light; nothing emits.
hard_bans: face in any frame — the young Valyrian is seen from behind, from above the shoulder, as a silhouette, or as hands only
wound, blister, burn, blood — contact on scales is depicted, never consequence
six-limbed dragons, third leg, fourth leg, arms, dangling feet; wings-forward crouch
legible text, letters, runes, glyphs anywhere (chains, buckles, staff wraps, rock, sky)
sun disc, shafts, god-light, bloom, lens flare, halo on any figure; nothing glows, ignites or emits
masonry courses/block ashlar/capitals/rose windows/light shafts in Valyrian stone — poured fusion only
ceremony, crowd, witnesses, spectacle — the witness is the camera
drg_val_002: DRG-VAL-002 (First-Bound Mount): ~28–33 years, 65 ft length, 95 ft wingspan, rider CHAR-VAL-002 (Stage B: heat-cured dark ox-hide riding coat, elbow gauntlets, wind-swept silver-gold locks with two thin temple braids, left-jawline heat-scar acquired IMG0526 — out of frame here with the face). Burnished volcanic-bronze dorsal scales (#8C522B), dark ash-grey belly plates, twin metallic-bronze horns swept back, three-ridged brow crest. Nothing glows; eyes never in emission in this batch.
anatomy_discipline: State the count numerically AND negatively in every frame with the animal; the 2x limb check is mandatory wherever it appears. Prefer side-on standing profile (both limb pairs visible) over any crouch; pure silhouette is acceptable at distance. This batch's single failure came exactly where the discipline predicts: a crouched, occluded, detail-lit animal whose count cannot be verified — IMG0572, returned unapproved.
crop_checks_required: 0572 (revision): two hind legs planted + two forelimbs vertical at 2x — PASS on revision 1.
0576: staff wraps are braided cord — no letters/marks at 3x — PASS.
0575/0577: iron, leather, buckle — no glyph/stamp/mark — PASS at 2x.
0578: hands at 3x — dry, pale, no red, no blister — PASS.
All frames: no face at any zoom — PASS (0572/0576 show ear/cheek edge only, no features).
inherited_lessons: 9b caldera architecture ban (hexagonal prisms, uneven height, jagged tops); §4h no-face line (held through 80+ frames, now held with the rider IN frame — from behind); 0569/0562 continuity object reuse (the fitted strap and ring go ON the dragon now); the testimony-to-dramatization hinge; 055–056 lesson that enforcement at composition time beats enforcement at crop time — honored nine times this batch, failed once, caught once.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — the morning the crossing begins, from below the ledge
scenes.qc_note: LAM 28mm from the caldera floor up a monumental hex-basalt wall: jagged prisms, no capitals, first warm raking dawn along the ledge lip. High on the rim: dragon in pure side-on rim silhouette, wings folded swept back; two legs visible planted on the crest, no extra limb dangles — outline enforces the count. One standing human silhouette from behind at the rim's edge, no face. Hexagonal prisms read as natural geology, not masonry. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — across the caldera, from behind the rider
scenes.qc_note: REVISION 1 — approved. First pass (e24a19dc…) came back crouched, hindquarter occluded, the mandatory 2x limb count unverifiable; the file was uploaded flagged and then trashed after this replacement was verified (recoverable in Drive trash). Re-render: standing side-on profile, two hind legs planted, both forelimbs vertical, wings folded flat and swept back. 2x crop at 1.7x of the chest: hind pair bent and planted, two fore columns planted apart, no third leg, no arms, nothing dangles — PASS. Head from behind at 1.5x: braids, soft ear rim only, no facial features — PASS. md5 re-read from Drive and matched (bc5b7679…).

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — the ledge, the animal, the man, one air
scenes.qc_note: WS 28mm deep focus: the man from behind lays one hand to the dragon's snout at the ledge edge. 2x limb check at the chest: far-left hind foot planted, second hind foot bent under the belly, one forelimb vertical center, second forelimb planted right — exactly four limbs, no third leg, no arms; wings swept flat along the back-plane, not forward. Rider from behind throughout, hair only, no face. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — the altitude of the threshold
scenes.qc_note: UWA 24mm geography: smoking cones under smoke-bent west wind, sea as a cold bright band, two figures tiny on the ridge — dragon in pure silhouette side-on, wings folded, four-limbed outline clean, nothing dangles; one human point beside it. No structures, no roads. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — the ledge itself, its tools
scenes.qc_note: MCU 50mm at stone height: the wide ox-hide neck strap with worn pale belly-edge and one plain hand-forged iron ring lying on wind-polished basalt — the same object as IMG0562. Ring and strap carry NO engraving, stamp or glyph at 2x; one plain bronze buckle. Raking first-light; one long hard shadow. No figures, no dragon, no text. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Dynamic medium lateral tracking angle — the approach, from beside him
scenes.qc_note: MS 35mm tracking from behind-right: silver-gold hair, two thin temple braids, ox-hide riding coat, elbow gauntlets, wrapped shepherd's staff — no face at any zoom. 2x limb check at the dragon's chest: one forelimb planted vertical, a folded forelimb wrist-claw center, one hind foot lying far-right under the wing — three feet visible, the fourth occluded by torso and wing; NO third leg, NO arms, nothing dangles; wings folded flat swept back, never forward. The staff's wrap is braided cord — no letters, no marks. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Compressed telephoto dramatic subject framing — the material of the bond, worn
scenes.qc_note: MCU 65mm compressed: high collar and shoulder of the Stage B riding coat, iron-and-ox-hide neck chain looped across the shoulder, one plain bronze buckle, dragon scale-wall behind. At 2x: no glyph, stamp, maker's mark or letter anywhere on iron, hide, leather or scale seams. Deep raking amber light, pores in the leather, no gloss. No face, no hands in frame. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium cinematic subject focus — the laying of hands, contact only
scenes.qc_note: MS 50mm from behind his right shoulder: two bare palms flat on copper-bronze scales, sleeves rolled, gauntlets unbuckled. Hands pale and cool, dry, grimy at the nails — at 3x no red, no blister, no mark anywhere. The wrist-cuff leather is plain; the chain at frame's right edge carries plain links only. Chain in left fist per brief. No face of man or animal; the eye is not in frame. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: Wide environmental storytelling tableau — the whole animal and the man, small in frame
scenes.qc_note: WS 35mm from frame-left against the light: the full animal side-on at the ledge lip — two bent hind legs planted, forelimbs under the chest occluded by the man and the wing plane; no third leg, no arms, nothing dangles; exactly four limbs implied, none contradictory. Wings held out slightly open in a deep cloak plane — a folding/spreading intermediate, NOT the forbidden wings-forward crouch; tall side-on posture. The man from behind, one bare hand on the neck, no face. Cones rimmed amber, sea a cold band, one white plume bent west. Approved first pass.

scenes.visual_beat: High-elevation geographic / scale reveal — the ledge as the lip of the world
scenes.qc_note: UWA 24mm near-aerial: the caldera spread beneath first light — blue shadows, amber-rimmed cones, smoke bending west, sea flooding the horizon. Lower-left shelf, two points: the dragon side-on, wings folded low along the body, hind pair bent planted, fore leg column planted, nothing dangles; one human point at its head, a glint of silver-gold hair, no face. Sentence cuts at 'on mortal—'. No other figures, no birds, no structures. Approved first pass.
